title: swertia tetrapetala subsp. micrantha
intro: Swertia tetrapetala subsp. micrantha, commonly known as Himalayan swertia, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Swertia tetrapetala subsp. micrantha include its ability to modulate blood sugar levels, exhibit immunomodulatory effects, and display anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include swertiamarin, sweroside, and gentiopicroside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
